Giovanni Gravili

November 13, 2026

Kind

Homepage/Twisting and charge transfer in the difluoroboron dyes/Dimethylamino chelate in acetonitrile/Relaxed S_0 scan of \theta_\mathrm{A}Open remoteEnglish

Automatic
  • Automatic

WarningCaveats
  • The relaxed S_0 scan of \theta_\mathrm{A} is complete: the dimethylamino group prefers the planar orientation, with a barrier of 36.8\,\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}} at the perpendicular geometry, where its nitrogen is pyramidal.
  • The points at 100 to 130^\circ stay on the uninverted branch above the lowest path, so the curve is usable with that limit, and the vertical excitations there describe that branch.

Job setup

Electrons and symmetry

The system’s electrons, charge, spin and point group, with the electron counts and multiplicity set by the nuclear charges Z_A and the total charge q:

N_\alpha+N_\beta=\sum_A Z_A-q,\qquad M_S=\frac{N_\alpha-N_\beta}{2},\qquad 2S+1=N_\alpha-N_\beta+1

Route keywords

Route keywords

Method, basis and job type.

Link 0 commands

This job’s memory, processors and files.

Internal options

IOp overrides; see the IOps Reference.

Coordinates

ModRedundant adds, freezes, scans or removes redundant internal coordinates; Gaussian may print a coordinate’s atoms reversed.

Molecule

Molecule specification

Title, charge, multiplicity and geometry source.

Starting geometry

The input structure. Bonds, angles and dihedrals the input’s coordinate section defines are measured on it.

Computed results

Scan profile

Relaxed energy at each converged point against each scanned coordinate, \varphi_{1,2,4,5}\;[{}^\circ]:

Molecular orbitals

HOMO and LUMO energies and their gap at the last point, \varphi_{1,2,4,5}=0.3297{}^\circ:

\Delta\epsilon=\epsilon_{\mathrm{LUMO}}-\epsilon_{\mathrm{HOMO}}

Levels near the gap, one column per symmetry:

  • Hover a level to name it; click it to highlight it.
  • Without symmetry, point group C_1, levels are counted from the frontier.
WarningSurfaces not drawn

Orbital and density surfaces are not drawn for the points of a scan.

Geometry trajectory

Every printed geometry in order; earlier frames fade.

Geometry optimization

The optimization made 225 convergence checks; forces and displacements are the maximum and RMS over the optimized coordinates.

Wavefunction convergence

The job reached 225 SCF solutions, one per geometry or state. The chart gives the cycles each one needed.

Files and resources

Checkpoints

Saved checkpoint, with energy and gap.

Resources

Program, resources and timing.
